subject: design/workbench-ui-v1
statement: The progress view derives each feature's row from corpus signals only, joined on the feature slug: the brainstorm record and its gate verdict; the PRD ledger's presence and status; designs whose `Serves` cite the feature (from the index's machine face) and their status; plan presence and status; review reports attached to each artifact. The row names the furthest artifact, its pending human gates (from the status ladders), and links every cell to its artifact. Anything the corpus does not state — implementation, merge, release — renders as **beyond the corpus**, honestly unknown (PRD FR-5); contested or unparseable states render as their defects (UB-3), never guessed.
